name: code-intel
description: Graph-first code intelligence for large codebases — serena (LSP navigation + symbol-level edits) and CBM (auto-sync knowledge graph + local semantic search) as MCP servers, plus ast-grep for structural search/rewrite. Binaries are located at runtime via env vars / PATH; no machine-local paths are committed.

name: codex-adapter
description: Call OpenAI Codex (gpt-5.x) from Claude Code via `codex exec`. Concurrent by design — no broker, no single-instance lock.

name: mvp-plugin
description: Reusable agent-coding harness: one curated skill set for Claude Code and Codex (same skills/ directory), plus /mvp-plugin:adopt, /mvp-plugin:update and /mvp-plugin:doctor to lay the per-repo residue (rules, hooks, CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, project overlay, beads) into any repository. One plugin in the mvp-harness marketplace (siblings: code-intel, codex-adapter).
